scope.flow: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange interacting with Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager using block.timestamp as deadline
scope.environment: L2TokenReceiverV2 contract on L2 interacting with Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager

statements.text: increaseLiquidityCurrentRange passes block.timestamp as the deadline argument to the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager, so the deadline check compares block.timestamp against the same value and is a no-op.
A transaction with insufficient gas may not be mined immediately.
A pending transaction is executed at a later time.
The deadline argument passed to the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager should enforce a real time bound so that a transaction cannot be executed after its intended deadline.
Delayed transactions can be executed by malicious actors or MEV bots at a disadvantage to the original submitter.
The deadline parameter provides no protective effect because the check is a no-op.

ambiguities: Report does not state who submits the delayed transaction or that anyone can call increaseLiquidityCurrentRange.
No concrete amount, value, or specific disadvantage is quantified for the delayed execution.
Report does not establish that a delayed transaction actually occurred; effects are described as possible.
